invariant: Permanent binding of signed assertion identity to digest, designation, canonical user and duty scope; claim identity cannot be recycled.
mustPreserve: Exact predecessor, monotonically increasing authority revision, stable signed subject, valid staff source proof.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: deterministic receiver identity derived from the admitted root fact, episode and generation: exact redelivery resolves the original result, a changed admission is a new identity

selectedCommandContracts.guard: Signature verified at source admission; permanent exact subject/duty/scope/digest claim. For recording, require exact granted active canonical staff proof bound to this change and held through FirmProfessionalDutyDesignationRecorded. Revocation does not require active staff. A local rejection fence forbids delayed apply; signed validity uses the frozen declared decision instant.
selectedCommandContracts.failure: Exact replay returns original result; proven superseded operation is terminal no-op; unavailable dependency/unknown append is transient; changed intent or invalid proof is permanent conflict/quarantine.

identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant-scoped platform / assertionId; the identity is established by the admitting owner or reactor named in the choreography, never by a caller request key; mutations bind CommandId to this exact identity.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.
commandNote: Process-dispatched replay claim keyed by platform/assertionId.
